notes: A logo is classified verified only when the endpoint returned HTTP 200 with a non-empty image content type/body; SVG responses were checked for an <svg> root.
API monograms are based on X-Logo-Fallback: monogram or an explicit monogram marker in the response body.
HTTP 429 is recorded as rate-limited, never as missing.
The 62 previous missing-catalog count was reconstructed with the saved catalog and prior audit matching order; actual current primary and alternate endpoint responses are recorded below.

The prior individual lists of 773 HTTP 429 and 44 ticker HTTP 404 were unavailable, so this report records live endpoint checks across the full stock universe rather than pretending to identify historical membership.
